Standing.Title: Our standing
Standing.RecognizedHint: Renown {n}+: the members know you and treat you as a friend.
Standing.Help: Attitude is how a group feels about you (Hostile, Indifferent, Friendly). Renown is how much it knows and respects you: it rises when you help the group and falls if you wrong it, never below 0. At {n}+ the members are Friendly by default. Members climb in rank as their renown grows, and each threshold brings perks.

Pack.Default: The generic ladder shipped with the module (no factions).
Pack.ResetConfirm: Remove the imported pack? The standing you recorded stays.
Pack.RanksHint: A faction can set its own ranks and perks in the pack.
Pack.Invalid: The pack has {n} problems; nothing was imported. Details in the console (F12).
